what.text: This page follows refugees from Burkina Faso living in Italy, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 7183 Burkinabe refugees in Italy, 2.0% of all refugees from Burkina Faso.
Mali hosts the most Burkinabe refugees, followed by Côte d'Ivoire, Togo and Ghana.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Burkina Faso with JNIM in every year from 2018 to 2025.
It also records armed conflict with the Islamic State group in Burkina Faso from 2019 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2004 at 5 refugees.
The figure is at its highest at the end of 2025, and the main years of displacement in the data are 2024 and 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Italy.
These are year-end totals for Italy only, reported to UNHCR.
